sources.cite: ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI, Computer Science Curricula 2023 (CS2023), knowledge areas (SEC: Security)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of the report's first part: 17 knowledge areas, among them SEC: Security; the fetch reached the table of contents, not the topic lists. The CMPCBS course cites CS2023 and its unit's open textbooks (dated 2026-11-11, REQ-245). The case's decision: a firewall change applied outside its approved window and scope is backed out by the documented plan and re-run through change control, which is the change management policy applied, not bypassed.

sources.cite: CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 Exam Objectives, Version 5.0, objective 1.3 'Explain the importance of change management processes and the impact to security'
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14 of a copy of CompTIA's objectives PDF hosted by a training provider (CompTIA's own partner link refused automated reading). Objective 1.3 lists business processes impacting security operations (approval process, ownership, stakeholders, impact analysis, test results, backout plan, maintenance window, standard operating procedure), technical implications (allow lists/deny lists, restricted activities, downtime, service restart, application restart, legacy applications, dependencies), documentation (updating diagrams, updating policies/procedures) and version control.
Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: Security+ V7 is available now, and V8 is expected on or around November 17, 2026. The page lists no objectives or domain weights.
